items.title: A quasi-projective morphism over a quasi-compact quasi-separated base is an open immersion into a projective morphism
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter morphisms.tex (Morphisms of Schemes)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma says that a quasi-projective morphism with quasi-compact quasi-separated base factors as an open immersion followed by a projective morphism (statement lines 10717-10722). The counted proof is substantial: it first replaces the ample sheaf by a power that is very ample, writes the quasi-coherent pushforward as a filtered colimit of finite type modules, covers the base by finitely many affines, lifts finitely many generating sections of the sheaf on each chart to a single member of the colimit so that the induced map becomes surjective, builds the resulting morphism into the projective bundle of that module, checks it is an immersion by factoring it through the local immersions, and finally applies the quasi-compact immersion statement to obtain a closed subscheme of the projective bundle through which the morphism factors as an open immersion (proof lines 10724-10774). It is H2: the construction and all its verifications are carried out in the counted span, with the cited inputs being standard very ampleness, colimit and immersion statements.
